decisions.statement: A body is found again by the object id git holds that body under and by nothing else.
An object id git does not hold is no body.
Nothing is put in its place.
A difference has one line either side of the lines that moved.
Both bodies a difference is taken between are written out first.
Whatever goes wrong is no difference rather than a difference that might be wrong.
The files a difference was taken over are gone before the difference is answered.

definition: the body an object id names, and what moved between it and the body that is there now
